crossRefs.note: Be glad in Yahweh, and rejoice, you righteous! Shout for joy, all you who are upright in heart!
Rejoice in Yahweh, you righteous! Praise is fitting for the upright.
For though the fig tree doesn’t flourish, nor fruit be in the vines; the labor of the olive fails, the fields yield no…
yet I will rejoice in Yahweh. I will be joyful in the God of my salvation!
Sing, daughter of Zion! Shout, Israel! Be glad and rejoice with all your heart, daughter of Jerusalem.
Rejoice in the Lord always! Again I will say, “Rejoice!”
Sing praise to Yahweh, you saints of his. Give thanks to his holy name.
God has spoken from his sanctuary: “I will triumph. I will divide Shechem, and measure out the valley of Succoth.
Aren’t you from everlasting, Yahweh my God, my Holy One? We will not die. Yahweh, you have appointed him for judgment.…
You who have purer eyes than to see evil, and who cannot look on perversity, why do you tolerate those who deal…
For they indeed, for a few days, punished us as seemed good to them; but he for our profit, that we may be partakers of…

translations.web: Be glad in Yahweh, you righteous people! Give thanks to his holy Name.
translations.bsb: Rejoice in the LORD, you righteous ones, and praise His holy name.
translations.kjv: Rejoice in the LORD, ye righteous; and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.
translations.asv: Be glad in Jehovah, ye righteous; And give thanks to his holy memorial name. Psalm 98 A Psalm.
